subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Her class created a map of public toilets with opening hours, cleanliness notes, and accessibility information.”?
options: The map helped delivery workers, older people, and families without air conditioning.
They found that many were in neighborhoods with more older residents.
However, students noticed that quieter neighborhoods with older residents had fewer online reports, possibly because people there did not use the website.
Many residents found it useful: parents with children, older people, delivery workers, and tourists.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The map helped delivery workers, older people, and families without air conditioning.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「They found that many were in neighborhoods with more older residents.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「However, students noticed that quieter neighborhoods with older residents had fewer online reports, possibly because people there did…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Her class created a map of public toilets with opening hours, cleanliness notes, and accessibility information. Many residents found it useful: parents…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Her class created a map of public toilets with opening hours, cleanliness notes, and accessibility information. Many residents found it useful: parents with children,…」，答案為「Many residents found it useful: parents with children, older people, delivery workers, and tourists.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Many residents found it useful: parents with children, older people, delivery workers, and tourists.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
